001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.pattern.format;
002
003import java.time.Instant;
004import java.time.ZoneId;
005import java.time.ZoneOffset;
006import java.util.function.Function;
007
008import org.eclipse.jdt.annotation.Nullable;
009
010import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogConfig;
011import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperties;
012import io.jstach.rainbowgum.ServiceRegistry;
013import io.jstach.rainbowgum.spi.RainbowGumServiceProvider.Configurator;
014
015/**
016 * Pattern Config needed for pattern keywords that is generally platform specific. Through
017 * property configuration there can only be one pattern config but through programmatic
018 * configuration there is no limit by creating custom {@link PatternCompiler}.
019 * <p>
020 * This class is also a configurator for easy programmatic registration with
021 * {@link LogConfig.Builder#configurator(Configurator)}.
022 *
023 * @see PatternCompiler
024 *
025 */
026public sealed interface PatternConfig extends Configurator {
027
028        /**
029         * Formatter properties prefix
030         */
031        public static final String PATTERN_CONFIG_PREFIX = LogProperties.ROOT_PREFIX + "pattern.config.{name}.";
032
033        /**
034         * Key Values that can be retrieved by various patterns.
035         */
036        public static final String PATTERN_PROPERY_PREFIX = LogProperties.ROOT_PREFIX + "pattern.property.";
037
038        /**
039         * Default zoneId if not specified.
040         * @return zone id.
041         */
042        public ZoneId zoneId();
043
044        /**
045         * Line separator for %n by default uses {@link System#lineSeparator()}.
046         * @return line separator.
047         */
048        public String lineSeparator();
049
050        /**
051         * Whether or not print escape outputs. If true than the color patterns will not
052         * decorate.
053         * @return false if ANSI escape sequences can be outputted.
054         */
055        public boolean ansiDisabled();
056
057        /**
058         * Key Value function for ad-hoc property replacements and lookup in various patterns.
059         * @return function.
060         * @see #PATTERN_PROPERY_PREFIX
061         */
062        @SuppressWarnings("exports")
063        public Function<String, @Nullable String> propertyFunction();
064
065        /**
066         * The baseline instant used by <code>%r</code>/<code>%relative</code> to compute
067         * elapsed milliseconds. Captured once (e.g. when this config is built) rather than
068         * recomputed, the same way logback's <code>RelativeTimeConverter</code> captures its
069         * start time once when constructed.
070         * @return start time.
071         */
072        public Instant startTime();
073
074        /**
075         * The first value returned by <code>%lsn</code>. Defaults to <code>0</code>.
076         * @return sequence number start.
077         */
078        public long sequenceNumberStart();
079
080        /**
081         * Creates a builder to create formatter config.
082         * @return builder.
083         * @apiNote {@link PatternConfig} implements {@link Configurator} so it can be
084         * registered at config time easily.
085         */
086        public static PatternConfigBuilder builder() {
087                return builder(LogProperties.DEFAULT_NAME);
088        }
089
090        /**
091         * Creates a builder to create formatter config.
092         * @param name for property resolution: {@value #PATTERN_CONFIG_PREFIX}.
093         * @return builder.
094         * @apiNote {@link PatternConfig} implements {@link Configurator} so it can be
095         * registered at config time easily.
096         */
097        public static PatternConfigBuilder builder(String name) {
098                return new PatternConfigBuilder(name);
099        }
100
101        /**
102         * Copies the config to builder.
103         * @param builder to receive properties.
104         * @param config to copy from.
105         * @return builder passed in.
106         */
107        public static PatternConfigBuilder copy(PatternConfigBuilder builder, PatternConfig config) {
108                builder.ansiDisabled(config.ansiDisabled());
109                builder.lineSeparator(config.lineSeparator());
110                builder.zoneId(config.zoneId());
111                builder.propertyFunction(config.propertyFunction());
112                builder.startTime(config.startTime());
113                builder.sequenceNumberStart(config.sequenceNumberStart());
114                return builder;
115        }
116
117        /**
118         * Default config.
119         * @return default config.
120         */
121        public static PatternConfig of() {
122                return StandardFormatterConfig.DEFAULT_FORMATTER_CONFIG;
123        }
124
125        /**
126         * Platform independent formatter config that will not change across timezones or
127         * platforms. <strong>The zoneId is UTC, line separator is LF, and ansi is
128         * disabled.</strong>
129         * @return config.
130         */
131        public static PatternConfig ofUniversal() {
132                return StandardFormatterConfig.UNIVERSAL_FORMATTER_CONFIG;
133        }
134
135        /**
136         * Creates a property function.
137         * @param properties log properties.
138         * @param prefix prefix keys before asking LogProperties.
139         * @return function.
140         */
141        @SuppressWarnings("exports")
142        public static Function<String, @Nullable String> propertyFunction(LogProperties properties, String prefix) {
143                record LogPropertiesPatternKeyValues(String prefix,
144                                LogProperties properties) implements Function<String, @Nullable String> {
145
146                        @Override
147                        public @Nullable String apply(String t) {
148                                String key = LogProperties.concatKey(prefix, t);
149                                return properties.valueOrNull(key);
150                        }
151
152                }
153                return new LogPropertiesPatternKeyValues(prefix, properties);
154        }
155
156        @Override
157        default boolean configure(LogConfig config, Pass pass) {
158                config.serviceRegistry().put(PatternConfig.class, ServiceRegistry.DEFAULT_SERVICE_NAME, this);
159                return true;
160        }
161
162}
163
164non-sealed interface DefaultFormatterConfig extends PatternConfig {
165
166        /**
167         * Default zoneId if not specified. If not overridden the system default will be used.
168         * @return zone id.
169         */
170        default ZoneId zoneId() {
171                return ZoneId.systemDefault();
172        }
173
174        /**
175         * Line separator for %n by default uses {@link System#lineSeparator()}.
176         * @return line separator.
177         */
178        default String lineSeparator() {
179                return System.lineSeparator();
180        }
181
182        /**
183         * Whether or not print escape outputs. If true than the color patterns will not
184         * decorate.
185         * @return false if ANSI escape sequences can be outputted.
186         */
187        default boolean ansiDisabled() {
188                return false;
189        }
190
191        @Override
192        default Function<String, @Nullable String> propertyFunction() {
193                return StandardPropertyFunction.INSTANCE;
194        }
195
196        /**
197         * Captured once when this interface is first loaded so all default configs share a
198         * single start time approximating application/logging startup.
199         */
200        Instant DEFAULT_START_TIME = Instant.now();
201
202        @Override
203        default Instant startTime() {
204                return DEFAULT_START_TIME;
205        }
206
207        @Override
208        default long sequenceNumberStart() {
209                return 0L;
210        }
211
212        enum StandardPropertyFunction implements Function<String, @Nullable String> {
213
214                INSTANCE;
215
216                @Override
217                public @Nullable String apply(String t) {
218                        return null;
219                }
220
221        }
222
223}
224
225enum StandardFormatterConfig implements DefaultFormatterConfig {
226
227        DEFAULT_FORMATTER_CONFIG(), //
228        UNIVERSAL_FORMATTER_CONFIG {
229                @Override
230                public String lineSeparator() {
231                        return "\n";
232                }
233
234                @Override
235                public ZoneId zoneId() {
236                        return ZoneId.from(ZoneOffset.UTC);
237                }
238
239                @Override
240                public boolean ansiDisabled() {
241                        return true;
242                }
243
244                @Override
245                public Instant startTime() {
246                        return Instant.EPOCH;
247                }
248        };
249
250}
251
252record SimpleFormatterConfig(ZoneId zoneId, String lineSeparator, boolean ansiDisabled,
253                Function<String, @Nullable String> propertyFunction, Instant startTime,
254                long sequenceNumberStart) implements PatternConfig {
255
256}
